description: This file is a shell script used for testing path collision detection and handling in a parallel checkout process of a Git repository. It sets up test scenarios, runs commands to verify collision detection, and validates that the system behaves correctly in cases like basename collisions, dirname collisions, symlink handling, and collision reporting during clone operations.

methods.name: test_workers_in_event_trace
methods.description: Verifies the number of worker events in the trace log to confirm parallel execution.
